notes.subject: Hematology and Blood Banking
notes.title: Sahli vs Cyanmethemoglobin
notes.content: Sahli's method converts Hb to acid hematin using N/10 HCl (read at 10 mins). Cyanmethemoglobin method uses Drabkin's reagent at 540 nm (reference gold standard).
